context_findings.finding: pre_api_request/post_api_request/api_request_error are bounded observer hooks; normal configured timeout dispatches callbacks on copied-context worker threads. Attaching OTel in pre hook does not set caller context.
Each bounded hook worker contextvars.copy_context().run(callback) is one-way; detach in later hook worker would be in a different Context.
Existing public ctx.register_middleware supports llm_execution; no new core extension point is needed.
run_llm_execution_middleware invokes callback chain inline and provides next_call single-use wrapper; downstream exceptions propagate rather than being retried by middleware.
Actual provider execution passes task_id, turn_id, api_request_id and session_id into execution middleware, after pre_api_request hook finishes.
_context_thread_target copies caller ContextVars; attached parent in execution middleware crosses to SDK workers.

Streaming worker uses _context_thread_target(self._run_call); selected cron/delegated inline path preserves caller ContextVars. Bridge spans bracket streaming call lifetime, not just generator creation.
Plugin stores its own provider as _tracer_provider; use explicit provider for selected instrumentor, preserve singleton/provider reuse. Global provider may be an earlier provider after reinit.

Pre API hook records active span under api:<task_id> and assigns supplied session.id; api_request_id is NOT recorded. Generic correlation.id extraction accepts only separately supplied correlation-id aliases, never api_request_id.

Use exact get_span(api:<task_id>) and validate supplied session.id plus a narrow pre-hook addition recording actual api_request_id as hermes.api_request.id. Do not infer attempt identity from task/session alone or session-stack fallback.

recommended_patch_custody.form: Small unified patch series pinned to existing installed source SHA256 and recorded upstream revision; preserve Brian Caffey Apache-2.0 attribution. Load/apply against a disposable temporary copy for in-memory synthetic SDK tests. Do not track a copied full plugin implementation or initialize another repository.
narrow_targets: hermes_otel/__init__.py registration of existing llm_execution middleware only when pilot gate selected
hermes_otel own helper/module implementing exact parent attach/detach and metadata export sanitization
hermes_otel/tracer.py provider processor attachment or export boundary; no second SDK/provider
hermes_otel/hooks/llm.py pre API hook: record actually supplied api_request_id as a trace-local attribute for exact middleware-parent matching; no global taxonomy or new identity
recommended_patch_custody.failure_boundary: Telemetry bridge may fail open before invocation; call next_call exactly once. Never catch provider exception then retry next_call. Detach in same Context finally, including errors/cancellation; require actual task-key, supplied session.id and supplied api_request_id match on active recording API span. Missing/stale/mismatched parent skips bridge rather than guessing.
recommended_patch_custody.privacy_boundary: Allowed values and fixed names, status descriptions, events, links and resources need filtering before exporter; content-off alone does not guard command/target/rollup/skill/error/span-name leak paths. Keep configured native logs/metrics/history/live-store off in inert profile and fixture exporter in-memory.

source_rules: Core narrow waist; plugin must not modify core files
Hermes Python dependency changes are owned by PM; no raw pip/uv mutation

applicable_methodology.overrides: User explicit local-only/no cloud/no agent-memory writes overrides home context cloud navigation and post-turn memory sync instructions. Live deployment, installing acquisition and real capture remain separate approval.
